description:
[measured] Test a trigger against our hourly archive BEFORE acting on it or alerting on
    it: when was this rule true before, and what did price do next? Returns matched hours,
    independent episodes (one per 24 h) with each one's 24 h and 72 h return, the outcome
    statistics (share up, median, quartiles, worst, best), the unconditional base rate over the
    same hours, whether the rule is true right now, and a `verdict` on sample size. The rule
    syntax is the condition-alert syntax, so a rule that tests well becomes create_alert(type=
    'condition', ...) with the same metric/op/threshold. Frequencies from our archive (hourly,
    since 2026-07 for BTC/ETH/SOL), NOT a forecast. Priced: $0.10 per call (x402), 20 prepaid credits, a free
    key's daily quota (100 metered calls), or Pro/Bot.

rules.description: Up to 3 rules joined by commas or 'and', each metric>threshold or metric<threshold. Metrics: price_chg_1h_pct, price_chg_24h_pct, oi_chg_1h_pct, oi_chg_24h_pct, funding_apr_pct, long_pct, liq_1h_usd, liq_24h_usd. Example: funding_apr_pct>40,oi_chg_24h_pct>5
